# Kehong Gong

> Senior Staff Engineer at Huawei Singapore Research Center (Ph.D., National University of Singapore). Research on motion capture and generation, video generation and world models, embodied AI (vision-language-action models for robot manipulation), and multimodal foundation models.

## Embodied AI

- [TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents](https://garfield-kh.github.io/TinyAstral/) (2026): a frozen open-weight teacher (~180B) improves only through harness edits (tools, feedback, memory, recovery) that frontier LLM agents propose and paired statistical tests accept (harness recursive self-improvement); RoboTwin success rises from 33.4% to 63.6%. The final harness is distilled into 0.8B-4B students: TinyAstral-4B reaches 62.8% and stays close to its teacher on six robot-manipulation benchmarks (RoboTwin, Guava, LIBERO-PRO, SimplerEnv, VLABench, EmbodiedBench), and runs closed-loop on a real SO-ARM101 arm served on Huawei Ascend Atlas A2. [Ascend recipe on GitCode](https://gitcode.com/cann/cann-recipes-embodied-ai).
- [Fast-VLA: You Only Think Once for Robot Manipulation](https://garfield-kh.github.io/FastVLA/) (also written FastVLA; arXiv 2026, [arXiv:2610.21389](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21389)): a vision-language-action policy that calls a frozen 4B vision-language model once per episode and keeps its layer-wise key-value cache as a fixed task memory; a lightweight online actor then predicts every action chunk from the current views and robot state. 92.46% / 92.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean / Randomized and 95.95% on LIBERO, with 10.9–17.1x lower amortized inference time than continually conditioned baselines. [Code](https://github.com/Garfield-kh/FastVLA), [model weights](https://huggingface.co/kehong/FastVLA-weights).

## Motion capture and generation

- [MoCapAnything V2: End-to-End Motion Capture for Arbitrary Skeletons](https://animotionlab.github.io/MoCapAnythingV2/) (ACM TOG / SIGGRAPH Asia 2026, [arXiv:2604.28130](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28130)): end-to-end motion capture for arbitrary skeletons.
- [MoCapAnything: Unified 3D Motion Capture for Arbitrary Skeletons from Monocular Videos](https://animotionlab.github.io/MoCapAnything/) (CVPR 2026, [arXiv:2512.10881](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10881)): unified 3D motion capture for arbitrary skeletons from monocular videos.
- [SWiT-4D: Sliding-Window Transformer for Lossless and Parameter-Free Temporal 4D Generation](https://animotionlab.github.io/SWIT4D/) (arXiv 2025, [arXiv:2512.10860](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10860)).
- [MotionMix: Weakly-Supervised Diffusion for Controllable Motion Generation](https://nhathoang2002.github.io/MotionMix-page/) (AAAI 2024, [arXiv:2401.11115](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.11115)).
- [TM2D: Bimodality Driven 3D Dance Generation via Music-Text Integration](https://garfield-kh.github.io/TM2D/) (ICCV 2023, [arXiv:2304.02419](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.02419)).
- [Priority-centric Human Motion Generation in Discrete Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.14480) (ICCV 2023).

## 3D human pose estimation

- [Learning to Augment Poses for 3D Human Pose Estimation in Images and Videos](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10050391) (IEEE TPAMI 2023).
- [PoseTriplet: Co-evolving 3D Human Pose Estimation, Imitation, and Hallucination under Self-supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.15625) (CVPR 2022, oral).
- [PoseAug: A Differentiable Pose Augmentation Framework for 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.02465) (CVPR 2021, oral, best paper candidate).
